# netactuate_router_vrf_dnat_rule (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages a destination NAT rule in a cloud router VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_vrf_dnat_rule" "example" {
  ip_version          = 4
  match_interface_id  = 12345
  match_network       = "192.0.2.0/24"
  protocol            = "TCP"
  router_id           = 12345
  translation_network = "192.0.2.0/24"
  vrf_id              = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version for this rule (4 or 6)
- `match_interface_id` (Number) The interface in which the traffic is going out
- `match_network` (String) The IP network to match against for outbound traffic
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match (TCP, UDP, or ICMP)
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router
- `translation_network` (String) The IP network you want to translate traffic to
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule
- `match_port_end` (Number) End of the match port range (1-32000)
- `match_port_start` (Number) Start of the match port range (1-32000)
- `priority_after_dnat_rule_id` (Number) Place this rule after the given DNAT rule ID
- `priority_location` (String) Place this rule at 'start', 'end', or 'after' another rule
- `translation_port_end` (Number) End of the translation port range (1-32000)
- `translation_port_start` (Number) Start of the translation port range (1-32000)

### Read-Only

- `dnat_rule_id` (Number) The DNAT rule ID assigned by the API
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_version_computed` (Number) The value is computed based on the 'ip_version' field

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_vrf_dnat_rule.example 12345
```
